title: Concept Clustering Engine: a plain-language overview (Signature)
description: Signature record. Overview: what the Concept Clustering Engine does and why archives need it. Signature original. The Signature clustering method sorts records into honest piles: each pile gets its label from its own most distinctive words, and records that fit nowhere are marked outliers instead of being forced in. t: How the Concept Clustering Engine works (Signature)
title: How the Concept Clustering Engine works (Signature)
description: Signature record. Overview: what the Concept Clustering Engine does and why archives need it. Signature original. The Signature approach clusters deterministically: fixed vectorization, fixed seeds, fixed merge thresholds — the same collection always yields the same piles. Each cluster carries a formation ledger with its distinctive terms, its size, and its cohesion score, so a curator can audit why any two records share a pile. Outliers are first-class citizens with their own ledger, never swept under a rug. This is a Signature-authored method, original to Justin Addam Higgins.
provenance: Signature-authored original method by Justin Addam Higgins (JAH). Property of Justin Addam Higgins.
